provenance.post_title: Iconic Encounter: Wreckers Reunion - Part Three
provenance.asset_description: In a dark workshop or laboratory, the iconic alchemist and iconic inventor take cover behind a low metal wall extending from the chassis of the inventor’s clockwork companion. The alchemist readies to throw a vial of fluid at an ooze that is breaking out of a glass tank in front of them.
